title: WooCommerce Product
description: A WooCommerce store product. Products can be simple, variable, grouped, or external/affiliate types. Variable products contain variations with their own pricing and stock. Prices are returned as decimal strings. All date fields use ISO8601 format.

id.description: Product unique identifier assigned by WooCommerce.

name.description: Product name displayed in the catalog and on product pages.

slug.description: URL-friendly product identifier used in the product permalink.

permalink.description: Full URL to the product page on the storefront.

date_created.description: Date the product was created in site timezone (ISO8601).

date_created_gmt.description: Date the product was created in UTC (ISO8601).

date_modified.description: Date the product was last modified in site timezone.

date_modified_gmt.description: Date the product was last modified in UTC.

type.description: Product type determining how it behaves at checkout.

featured.description: Whether the product is marked as featured in the catalog.

catalog_visibility.description: Visibility in the store catalog and search results.

description.description: Full product description. May contain HTML.

short_description.description: Short product description shown in catalog listings. May contain HTML.

sku.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier. Must be unique across all products and variations.

price.description: Current product price (either regular or sale price) as a decimal string.

regular_price.description: Regular (non-sale) product price as a decimal string.

sale_price.description: Sale price as a decimal string. Empty string when not on sale.

date_on_sale_from.description: Date the sale price becomes active. Null if not scheduled.

date_on_sale_to.description: Date the sale price ends. Null if not scheduled.

on_sale.description: Whether the product is currently selling at the sale price.

purchasable.description: Whether the product can be added to the cart and purchased.

total_sales.description: Total number of units sold across all time.

virtual.description: Whether the product is virtual and does not require shipping.

downloadable.description: Whether the product is downloadable and grants file access after purchase.

downloads.description: Downloadable files associated with a downloadable product.

download_limit.description: Number of times a customer may download the file. -1 for unlimited.

download_expiry.description: Number of days before the download link expires. -1 for unlimited.

external_url.description: URL for external/affiliate products where the purchase is completed.

button_text.description: Add-to-cart button label for external products.

tax_class.description: Tax class slug applied to this product. Empty for standard rate.

manage_stock.description: Whether stock quantity management is enabled for this product.

stock_quantity.description: Current stock quantity. Null when manage_stock is false.

backorders.description: Whether backorders are allowed when stock runs out.

backordered.description: Whether the product is currently on backorder.

low_stock_amount.description: Quantity threshold at which a low stock notice is triggered.

sold_individually.description: Whether only one unit can be purchased per order.

weight.description: Product weight as a string in the store's configured weight unit.

shipping_required.description: Whether the product requires physical shipping.

shipping_taxable.description: Whether shipping charges on this product are taxable.

shipping_class.description: Shipping class slug assigned to this product.

shipping_class_id.description: ID of the shipping class assigned to this product.

reviews_allowed.description: Whether customer reviews are enabled for this product.

average_rating.description: Average customer review rating as a decimal string (e.g. 4.50).

upsell_ids.description: Product IDs shown as upsells on this product's page.

cross_sell_ids.description: Product IDs shown as cross-sells in the cart.

parent_id.description: Parent product ID for product variations.

purchase_note.description: Optional note sent to the customer after purchase.

categories.description: Product categories this product is assigned to.

tags.description: Product tags assigned to this product.

images.description: Images associated with the product. First image is the featured image.

attributes.description: Product attributes. For variable products, used to define available variations.

default_attributes.description: Default attribute values pre-selected on the variable product page.

variations.description: IDs of product variations for variable products.

grouped_products.description: IDs of products included in a grouped product.

menu_order.description: Sort order position for the product in catalog listings.

meta_data.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs attached to the product.

Dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of a product in the store's configured dimension unit.

Image.description: An image attachment associated with a product.

date_modified.description: Date the image was last modified.

ProductAttribute.description: A product attribute with its available options.

id.description: Global attribute ID. 0 for custom (non-taxonomy) attributes.

position.description: Display order position of the attribute on the product page.

visible.description: Whether the attribute is visible on the product page.

variation.description: Whether this attribute is used to define product variations.

options.description: Available option values for this attribute.

TermRef.description: A reference to a taxonomy term (category or tag).

Download.description: A downloadable file associated with a digital product.

name.description: Display name of the download file.

file.description: URL or path of the downloadable file.

value.description: Metadata value. Type varies by key.
